bug_info.bug_desc: The EDN entropy request output was driven directly from the kmac_entropy FSM and defaulted to 0. When the EDN wait timer expired, the FSM left StRandEdn and entered the error path, so entropy_req_o was deasserted before the EDN side acknowledged the request. Dropping an outstanding request can leave the prim_sync_reqack_data CDC/request-ack handshake in an inconsistent state and caused assertion failures. The old kmac.sv code also disabled req_chk_i whenever an entropy error or entropy FSM error was present, masking the dropped-request scenario instead of preventing it.
bug_info.fix_hint: Hold the EDN request high until it is acknowledged. In kmac_entropy, introduce an internal entropy_req signal plus a hold latch, drive entropy_req_o from entropy_req OR the hold latch, and clear the hold only when entropy_ack_i is seen. Keep the FSM driving the internal entropy_req; in kmac.sv, set req_chk_i to 1'b1 since the request is now held until ack.
